description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the deeded beach access or take the complimentary tram- Access to Seacrest's 12,000-square-foot community pool and multiple community parks (including one directly across the street)- 3 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout*Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Photos and additional details coming soon!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
